title: rapt: ai–powered iot framework for real-time respiratory disorders monitoring and prediction
core_idea: Design and evaluate RAPT, an AI-powered e-health framework that combines audio-derived features (mel spectrograms) and standardized patient metadata (age, sex, BMI) via a dual-branch convolutional neural network to enable continuous, remote categorization and monitoring of pulmonary conditions, with a Gradio interface and compatibility for IoT-enabled stethoscopes and wearables.
tldr: This work proposes RAPT, a multimodal AI + IoT system that integrates respiratory audio and clinical metadata through a dual-branch CNN to support remote, real-time monitoring and prediction of respiratory disorders using smart stethoscopes and wearable devices.
